subject: NEXT GROUP clause
notes: kb/Work PB957. WITH RESET arms a one-shot flag consumed by the next PageFeed, between the page footing and the page heading (§14.9.16.4 GR6d): the forms golden's third page heading shows PH 1, not PH 3; the RH form shows PH 1 on page 2. DETERMINATION: §8.4.3.15.4 GR2 says PAGE-COUNTER 'is reset to 1 when a report group that contains a NEXT GROUP clause with a RESET phrase is printed'; the clause's own GR6 and §14.9.16.4 GR6d both time it at the next page advance, and the specific rules are implemented.
